note.title: Conditional Access condition: time (working hours)
note.what: A time condition on a Conditional Access policy: the policy applies on the days and hours you set, or outside them. Microsoft has not documented it, but community admins set it through the beta API and tested it: a Block policy with the working hours excluded blocked every sign-in outside 08:00-16:00 and at the weekend, and let sign-ins inside the window through.
uses: Block sign-ins outside working hours for one group (contractors, shift staff, a pilot group) - start in report-only
Ask for MFA or a compliant device outside office hours instead of blocking
Always exclude the emergency access (break-glass) accounts - a time block can lock admins out at night
Supported today without this condition: switch a policy on and off on a schedule (Azure Automation runbook - Tony Redmond's article)

values.name: times.includeAllTimes
values.what: true + excludeDays: the policy applies all the time except the excluded window (Patyk's test: blocked outside Mon-Fri 07:00-15:00 UTC). false + includeDays: the policy applies only inside the window (Bradley's body).

values.name: times.includeDays / times.excludeDays
values.accepted: one window: daysOfWeek, timeZone, startTime, endTime, allDay
values.what: The days and hours the policy covers (include) or skips (exclude). Both articles set one of the two and send the other as null.

values.name: …Days.daysOfWeek
values.accepted: lowercase English day names: "monday" … "friday" in both articles
values.what: The days of the window.

values.name: …Days.timeZone
values.what: UTC has no summer time: 07:00-15:00 UTC is 08:00-16:00 in Poland in winter (CET) and 09:00-17:00 in summer (CEST).

values.name: …Days.startTime / …Days.endTime
values.what: Start and end of the window on each listed day.

values.name: …Days.allDay
values.what: true presumably means the whole day - no article tested it.

values.name: times.includeRange / times.excludeRange
values.accepted: timeZone, startDateTime, endDateTime (all null in the portal's code)
values.what: A date range (from - to). Daniel Bradley found the shape in the admin center's JavaScript; nobody has published a working range yet.

caveats: Undocumented and beta only - Microsoft may rename it, change it or switch it off without notice.
Only "UTC" is accepted. Move the hours twice a year (last Sunday of March and of October) or the window shifts by one hour.

The admin center does not show it: the policy lists every condition as "Not configured". The sign-in log names the policy that blocked, but its Conditions section is empty - write the reason in the policy's name.

Conditional Access is checked when a token is issued. Access tokens live 60-90 minutes, and with Continuous Access Evaluation (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint) up to 28 hours - a session started inside the window may go on after it closes. Neither article tested this.

Mail.ReadBasic.title: Read basic mail in all mailboxes
Mail.ReadBasic.app: Allows the app to read basic mail properties in all mailboxes without a signed-in user. Includes all properties except body, previewBody, attachments and any extended properties.
Mail.ReadBasic.del: Allows the app to read email in the signed-in user's mailbox except body, previewBody, attachments and any extended properties.

Mail.ReadWrite.title: Read and write mail in all mailboxes
Mail.ReadWrite.app: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete mail in all mailboxes without a signed-in user. Does not include permission to send mail.
Mail.ReadWrite.del: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete email in user mailboxes. Does not include permission to send mail.

MailboxFolder.Read.title: Read a user's mailbox folders
MailboxFolder.Read.del: Allows the app to read the user's mailbox folders, on behalf of the signed-in user.

MailboxFolder.ReadWrite.title: Read and write a user's mailbox folders
MailboxFolder.ReadWrite.del: Allows the app to read and write the user's mailbox folders, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Organization.ReadWrite.All.title: Read and write organization information
Organization.ReadWrite.All.app: Allows the app to read and write the organization and related resources, without a signed-in user. Related resources include things like subscribed skus and tenant branding information.
Organization.ReadWrite.All.del: Allows the app to read and write the organization and related resources, on behalf of the signed-in user. Related resources include things like subscribed skus and tenant branding information.

Place.Read.All.title: Read all company places
Place.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read company places (conference rooms and room lists) for calendar events and other applications, without a signed-in user.
Place.Read.All.del: Allows the app to read your company's places (conference rooms and room lists) for calendar events and other applications, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Place.ReadWrite.All.title: Read and write organization places
Place.ReadWrite.All.app: Allows the app to manage organization places (conference rooms and room lists) for calendar events and other applications, on behalf of the signed-in user.
Place.ReadWrite.All.del: Allows the app to manage organization places (conference rooms and room lists) for calendar events and other applications, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Policy.Read.All.title: Read your organization's policies
Policy.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read all your organization's policies without a signed in user.
Policy.Read.All.del: Allows the app to read your organization's policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

Policy.Read.AuthenticationMethod.title: Read authentication method policies
Policy.Read.AuthenticationMethod.app: Allows the app to read all authentication method policies for the tenant, without a signed-in user.
Policy.Read.AuthenticationMethod.del: Allows the app to read the authentication method policies, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguratio.title: Read and write your organization's application configuration policies
Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguratio.app: Allows the app to read and write your organization's application configuration policies, without a signed-in user.  This includes policies such as activityBasedTimeoutPolicy, claimsMappingPolicy, homeRealmDiscoveryPolicy, tokenIssuancePolicy  and tokenLifetimePolicy.
Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguratio.del: Allows the app to read and write your organization's application configuration policies on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes policies such as activityBasedTimeoutPolicy, claimsMappingPolicy, homeRealmDiscoveryPolicy,  tokenIssuancePolicy and tokenLifetimePolicy.

Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod.title: Read and write all authentication method policies
Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod.app: Allows the app to read and write all authentication method policies for the tenant, without a signed-in user.
Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod.del: Allows the app to read and write the authentication method policies, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Policy.ReadWrite.Authorization.title: Read and write your organization's authorization policy
Policy.ReadWrite.Authorization.app: Allows the app to read and write your organization's authorization policy without a signed in user. For example, authorization policies can control some of the permissions that the out-of-the-box user role has by default.
Policy.ReadWrite.Authorization.del: Allows the app to read and write your organization's authorization policy on behalf of the signed-in user.  For example, authorization policies can control some of the permissions that the out-of-the-box user role has by default.

Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess.title: Read and write your organization's conditional access policies
Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess.app: Allows the app to read and write your organization's conditional access policies, without a signed-in user.
Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess.del: Allows the app to read and write your organization's conditional access policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

Policy.ReadWrite.CrossTenantAccess.title: Read and write your organization's cross tenant access policies
Policy.ReadWrite.CrossTenantAccess.app: Allows the app to read and write your organization's cross-tenant access policies and configuration for automatic user consent settings to suppress consent prompts for users of the other tenant on behalf of the signed-in user.
Policy.ReadWrite.CrossTenantAccess.del: Allows the app to read and write your organization's cross-tenant access policies and configuration for automatic user consent settings to suppress consent prompts for users of the other tenant on behalf of the signed-in user.

Policy.ReadWrite.SecurityDefaults.title: Read and write your organization's security defaults policy
Policy.ReadWrite.SecurityDefaults.app: Allows the app to read and write your organization's security defaults policy, without a signed-in user.
Policy.ReadWrite.SecurityDefaults.del: Allows the app to read and write your organization's security defaults policy on behalf of the signed-in user.

RoleManagement.Read.All.title: Read role management data for all RBAC providers
RoleManagement.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read role-based access control (RBAC) settings for all RBAC providers without a signed-in user. This includes reading role definitions and role assignments.
RoleManagement.Read.All.del: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for all RBAC providers, on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes reading role definitions and role assignments.

RoleManagement.Read.Directory.title: Read all directory RBAC settings
RoleManagement.Read.Directory.app: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, without a signed-in user.  This includes reading directory role templates, directory roles and memberships.
RoleManagement.Read.Directory.del: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes reading directory role templates, directory roles and memberships.

RoleManagement.ReadWrite.CloudPC.title: Read and write all Cloud PC RBAC settings
RoleManagement.ReadWrite.CloudPC.app: Allows the app to read and manage the Cloud PC role-based access control (RBAC) settings, without a signed-in user. This includes reading and managing Cloud PC role definitions and memberships.
RoleManagement.ReadWrite.CloudPC.del: Allows the app to read and manage the Cloud PC role-based access control (RBAC) settings, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes reading and managing Cloud PC role definitions and role assignments.

RoleManagementPolicy.Read.Directory.title: Read all policies for privileged role assignments of your company's directory
RoleManagementPolicy.Read.Directory.app: Allows the app to read policies for privileged role-based access control (RBAC) assignments of your company's directory, without a signed-in user.
RoleManagementPolicy.Read.Directory.del: Allows the app to read policies for privileged role-based access control (RBAC) assignments of your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user.

RoleManagementPolicy.ReadWrite.Directory.title: Read, update, and delete all policies for privileged role assignments of your company's directory
RoleManagementPolicy.ReadWrite.Directory.app: Allows the app to read, update, and delete policies for privileged role-based access control (RBAC) assignments of your company's directory, without a signed-in user.
RoleManagementPolicy.ReadWrite.Directory.del: Allows the app to read, update, and delete policies for privileged role-based access control (RBAC) assignments of your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Sites.FullControl.All.title: Have full control of all site collections
Sites.FullControl.All.app: Allows the app to have full control of all site collections without a signed in user.
Sites.FullControl.All.del: Allows the application to have full control of all site collections on behalf of the signed-in user.

Sites.Read.All.title: Read items in all site collections
Sites.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read documents and list items in all site collections without a signed in user.
Sites.Read.All.del: Allows the application to read documents and list  items in all site collections on behalf of the signed-in user

Sites.ReadWrite.All.title: Read and write items in all site collections
Sites.ReadWrite.All.app: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete documents and list items in all site collections without a signed in user.
Sites.ReadWrite.All.del: Allows the application to edit or delete documents and list items in all site collections on behalf of the signed-in user.

Synchronization.Read.All.title: Read all Azure AD synchronization data.
Synchronization.Read.All.app: Allows the application to read Azure AD synchronization information, without a signed-in user.
Synchronization.Read.All.del: Allows the app to read Azure AD synchronization information, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Synchronization.ReadWrite.All.title: Read and write all Azure AD synchronization data.
Synchronization.ReadWrite.All.app: Allows the application to configure the Azure AD synchronization service, without a signed-in user.
Synchronization.ReadWrite.All.del: Allows the app to configure the Azure AD synchronization service, on behalf of the signed-in user.

Tasks.Read.title: Read user's tasks and task lists
Tasks.Read.del: Allows the app to read the signed-in user’s tasks and task lists, including any shared with the user. Doesn't include permission to create, delete, or update anything.

Tasks.Read.All.title: Read all users’ tasks and tasklist
Tasks.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read all users’ tasks and task lists in your organization, without a signed-in user.

Tasks.ReadWrite.title: Create, read, update, and delete user’s tasks and task lists
Tasks.ReadWrite.del: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete the signed-in user's tasks and task lists, including any shared with the user.

User.Read.title: Sign in and read user profile
User.Read.del: Allows users to sign-in to the app, and allows the app to read the profile of signed-in users. It also allows the app to read basic company information of signed-in users.

User.ReadBasic.All.title: Read all users' basic profiles
User.ReadBasic.All.app: Allows the app to read a basic set of profile properties of other users in your organization without a signed-in user. Includes display name, first and last name, email address, open extensions, and photo.
User.ReadBasic.All.del: Allows the app to read a basic set of profile properties of other users in your organization on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes display name, first and last name, email address and photo.

User.ReadWrite.title: Read and write access to user profile
User.ReadWrite.del: Allows the app to read your profile. It also allows the app to update your profile information on your behalf.

WindowsUpdates.Read.All.title: Read all Windows update deployment settings
WindowsUpdates.Read.All.app: Allows the app to read all Windows update deployment settings for the organization without a signed-in user.
WindowsUpdates.Read.All.del: Allows the app to read all Windows update deployment settings for the organization on behalf of the signed-in user.

WindowsUpdates.ReadWrite.All.title: Read and write all Windows update deployment settings
WindowsUpdates.ReadWrite.All.app: Allows the app to read and write all Windows update deployment settings for the organization without a signed-in user.
WindowsUpdates.ReadWrite.All.del: Allows the app to read and write all Windows update deployment settings for the organization on behalf of the signed-in user.

cats.Conditional Access: Who may sign in to what, from where and how - the policies that decide every sign-in.
cats.Authentication methods: Which sign-in methods users may register and use (passkeys, Authenticator, SMS, voice, password, certificates).
cats.Cross-tenant access: What users of other Entra organizations may do in your tenant, and your users in theirs.
cats.Default user permissions: What every user without an admin role may do: register apps, create groups, read other users, create agent blueprints.
cats.Security defaults: The free baseline protection for tenants without Conditional Access.
cats.App management & consent: Rules for app registrations and enterprise apps: credentials, consent, token lifetimes.
cats.Agents & Copilot: AI agents and Copilot: agent identities, blueprints, interactions.
cats.Global Secure Access: Microsoft's security service edge: Internet Access, Private Access, compliant network.
cats.Identity governance: Access reviews, access packages, lifecycle workflows, PIM and roles.
cats.Planner, Places & productivity: Planner, Places (rooms, desks), Bookings, To Do, OneNote.
cats.Identity protection: Risky users, risky sign-ins and risky agents.
cats.Intune & devices: Intune device, app and enrollment settings, device registration.
cats.Security & Defender: Defender XDR: alerts, incidents, hunting, Secure Score, attack simulation.
cats.Purview & compliance: Labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery and audit.
cats.Organization & sync: The tenant itself: organization settings, domains, directory synchronization.
cats.Files & SharePoint: SharePoint sites, OneDrive, files and lists.
cats.Reports & audit: Sign-in and audit logs, usage reports.
cats.Other: Everything the other technologies do not cover.
